nodes.speaker: caramel
nodes.text: Hi. I made a bet with my friends that I could talk to the most beautiful mare. So, how do we spend their bits?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Am... Well, you can spend it at my bar.

nodes.speaker: caramel
nodes.text: It's a good thing I bought insurance, because when I saw you, my heart stopped.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Er... Maybe you should go to the doctor. I saw there just the mare you need.

nodes.speaker: caramel
nodes.text: You owe me a cocktail because when I looked at you, I dropped mine.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Please take care of the glasses from my bar more seriously. Even though I have an infinity of them, you won't earn my attitude that way.

nodes.speaker: caramel
nodes.text: Do you believe in love at first sight, or should I pass you by one more time?

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: In order for me to really like you, you don't have enough wings on your back...

nodes.speaker: caramel
nodes.text: I wanted to ask if you have a spare heart, because mine just got broken.
